verdict.rationale: Insomnia documents Role-based access control (RBAC) for fine-grained control over who can access which resources, plus organizations to share collections/environments securely with colleagues, directly matching the platform-engineer's need to control viewing/editing of APIs and collections. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of RBAC granularity (e.g., view-vs-edit distinctions per collection), and details on role customization or audit trails.
